messages:
sara: Quick UX pass on the Private setup wizard network step. I prototyped a small inline network map that shows the agent host, control plane, and allowed CIDR ranges layered on top. Thoughts?

vijay: Love the idea of a visual. My worry: it may be confusing for customers that don't know CIDR notation. Can we show both a visual and a compact textual summary (e.g., 'Agent IP: 3.4.5.6, Allowed CIDR: 3.4.0.0/16')?

bryce: Agreed — visual + text. Also make the map optional (toggle) to keep the default compact for advanced users. On small screens the map could collapse into a single-line connectivity synopsis with an icon.

lina: Accessibility nits: if we add a map, provide a textual alt summary that SRs announce when the panel opens. Use role="img" with aria-label like 'Network diagram: agent cannot reach control plane; allowed CIDR does not include agent IP.'

paul: For UX flow: when a probe fails, highlight the offending CIDR or port on the map and show a timeline below with recent probe attempts (success/fail) so users can see flakiness. Timeline should be a simple list: timestamp + outcome icon.

sara: Good call on timeline — helps debug intermittent issues. Timeline items should be copyable so support can paste into tickets.

vijay: Microcopy: current 'Agent failed' is cold. Proposal: 'Connectivity check failed — we couldn't reach Redwood from your agent. Verify SSH (port 22) and that your agent's IP is included in allowed CIDRs.' Mobile short: 'Agent can't reach Redwood — check SSH & CIDR.'

bryce: For CTAs, change 'Help' to 'View remediation steps' and make that deep-link to the KB with anchors to SSH, egress, and proxy docs. docs-bot: https://docs.redwood.ai/private/setup#connectivity (placeholder).

lina: Keyboard behavior: map should be reachable via tab; each interactive element (CIDR shapes, pins) should have a focus ring and descriptive aria-labels like 'Allowed CIDR 3.4.0.0/16, contains agent IP: no'. Also ensure the timeline is a list with role="list" and each entry role="listitem" so SRs can navigate it.

paul: Visual affordances: failing CIDR shapes get high-contrast outline and an error icon; passing shapes are muted. Avoid color-only signals. Also include a small legend.

sara: UX edge-case: for customers behind NAT or with ephemeral egress IPs, show a 'Possible NAT detected' hint and a link to 'how to test from the same network' with a copyable curl command: `curl -s https://ifconfig.me` so they can compare IPs.

vijay: Logging: parsed summary + timeline + 'Show raw probe output' collapsed by default. Raw output should be preformatted and copyable.

bryce: ARIA & focus for actions: when a new 'View remediation' anchor appears after a probe run, do NOT auto-focus it. Announce it via the row's aria-live region instead. If user clicks Retry, keep focus on the Retry button.

aria-bot: Accessibility checklist generated: 1) map has aria-label and keyboard hotspots; 2) timeline uses role=list/listitem; 3) scoped aria-live on probe rows; 4) focus not stolen on autoscan; 5) color contrast >= 4.5:1; 6) prefers-reduced-motion respected for timeline pulsing.

docs-bot: Saved prototype + docs links: Figma https://figma.com/mock/network-map-901, KB https://docs.redwood.ai/private/setup#connectivity.

sara: Next steps: I'll iterate the mock with optional map toggle and timeline; Vijay to write the copy variants; Lina to draft ARIA attrs; Bryce to prot the legend & small-screen collapse. Sync in 30.

paul: I'll mock the copyable curl snippet and timeline export to clipboard.

sara: thanks all :rocket:
